owner.title: Owner communication
owner.form.summaryHint: The summary goes into the medical record: write what the owner was told and what they asked for.
owner.form.invalid: Write a summary of the contact.
owner.bulletin.title: WhatsApp bulletin
owner.bulletin.hint: The text is editable before sending. Write in plain language, no jargon.
owner.bulletin.cost: Every message sent has a cost, charged to the clinic, never to the owner.
owner.bulletin.channel: Messages go out through the official WhatsApp API, from the clinic number, and every send is kept in the medical record.
owner.optIn.required: The owner has to opt in first
owner.optIn.requiredBody: {{name}} has not yet authorised receiving messages from the clinic on WhatsApp. Record the consent in the owner's record: without it, Meta and the LGPD do not allow sending. In the meantime, call and record the contact here on the side.
owner.optIn.unknown: The owner's consent could not be confirmed. Sending only goes through with the opt-in on file.
owner.draft.doneToday: The team has already looked after them {{times}} times today, all as planned.
owner.draft.nothingYet: The team is keeping an eye on them around the clock.
owner.draft.next: The next care round is due at {{time}}.
owner.draft.closing: We will let you know if anything changes. Talk to us whenever you like.
owner.footer: An informed owner calls less and trusts more. The bulletin almost writes itself from what the team already logged on the sheet.
owner.lookupFailed: The owner's record was not loaded: name, phone and consent do not appear here. Recording a contact still works, because the link is resolved on the server.
owner.deliveryNote: What is here is what the clinic recorded. Delivery and read confirmations never reach the system, so they are not shown.
owner.optIn.blocked: {{name}} has not yet authorised receiving messages from the clinic on WhatsApp, and without the recorded consent Meta and the LGPD forbid sending. Record the consent below once they authorise it, or call and record the contact on the side.
owner.optIn.recordBody: The consent is the owner's, not the clinic's: record it only after {{name}} authorises receiving messages from the clinic on WhatsApp. It is stored with date, time and the name of whoever recorded it. That is the proof required by the LGPD and by Meta.
owner.optIn.confirmLabel: I confirm that {{name}} has authorised receiving the clinic's messages on WhatsApp.
owner.bulletin.queued: Bulletin recorded in the chart and queued for sending.
owner.bulletin.deliveryNote: The bulletin goes out through the official WhatsApp API, from the clinic's number, and every send is recorded in the chart. The system receives no delivery or read confirmation.
